ranked.headline: Drug and cell representations learned with network and mechanistic priors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal papers pair learned encoders with graph, causal, or structural priors for drug, target, and perturbation prediction.

ranked.headline: Tissue spatial context is being coupled to gene expression and cell-type models
ranked.summary: Spatially aware models now link histology, multi-omic tissue data, and single-cell expression, extending gene-level inference to tissue architecture.

ranked.headline: Graph and tensor methods integrate incomplete spatial and single-cell multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Incomplete and cross-platform spatial multi-omics data are driving new integration, imputation, and embedding methods, mostly in preprints.

ranked.headline: Chromatin profiles used to infer regulatory activity from multimodal epigenomic data
ranked.summary: Single-cell multiome atlases and explainable models now link histone marks and accessibility to transcription, mutation rates and chromatin contacts.

ranked.headline: Generative and language-model frameworks repurposed for molecular and protein design
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language model and co-folding representations are being transferred to generative design and affinity ranking tasks.

ranked.headline: Deep models map sequence and single-cell inputs to regulatory activity and expression
ranked.summary: AlphaGenome shows a modality gap in personal-genome prediction, while promoter and cis-element models predict expression from sequence.

ranked.headline: Orthology-guided tools compare proteins, RNAs and gene content across species
ranked.summary: Comparative genomics is extending from usable orthology software to regulatory RNAs, habitat-linked gene catalogues and PTM mapping.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic data inferring methylation activity and somatic mutations
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomes are being mined for latent methylation activity, somatic mutations, and subclonal heterogeneity.

ranked.headline: Generative models now sample protein and GPCR dynamics instead of static structures
ranked.summary: STAR-MD and GPCRLMD generate microsecond protein and all-atom GPCR-ligand trajectories, aiming to replace costly MD simulation.

ranked.headline: Priors and generative models test single-cell readout fidelity from sparse, noisy data
ranked.summary: Sparse, error-prone single-cell data call for explicit priors and error models to recover reliable cellular and lineage states.

ranked.headline: Integration tools for single-cell and spatial omics are being benchmarked and extended
ranked.summary: Parameter choices and new integration platforms now shape how single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets are combined and interpreted.

ranked.headline: Learned protein and membrane representations guide peptide, antibody, and lipid design
ranked.summary: Structure-aware graph, geometric, and data-efficient models are now being applied to membrane interfaces and lipid nanoparticle design.

ranked.headline: Open tools expose annotation, criteria, and negative-set choices in genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release inspectable tools that make annotation, variant, and prioritization choices testable against explicit evidence.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models resolve alleles, variants and trans-regulatory links
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend latent-variable inference to allele-level genotyping, multitrait fine-mapping and single-cell trans-eQTL mapping.

ranked.headline: Software tools extend sequence variation, coevolution, and genotype-phenotype analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release computational tools for comparing genomes, coevolving residues, and genotype-phenotype data from sequence sources.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies separate alleles in polyploid and heterozygous plant genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C phasing now yields near telomere-to-telomere autopolyploid assemblies, enabling allele-level analysis of expression and recombination.

ranked.headline: Automated long-read and pangenome tools characterize microbial genomes and plasmids
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair long-read assembly and pangenome graphs with systematic benchmarks of microbial sequence tools.

ranked.headline: Network priors and robustness guide high-dimensional multi-omics feature integration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair network priors with multiomic models to handle correlated, high-dimensional, and partially missing data.

ranked.headline: Spatially aware methods detect and formally test spatial patterns in omics data
ranked.summary: Spatial omics methods now test localization patterns with formal inference rather than only describing expression levels.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models explain cellular transitions, oscillations, and stress responses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply mechanistic kinetic and ODE models to gene circuits, Notch signaling, and bacterial stress responses.

ranked.headline: Bias-aware quantification and model-based inference refine noncoding RNA and single-cell…
ranked.summary: Library choice and ligation bias now shape noncoding RNA measurements, prompting bias-aware quantification and single-cell inference methods.

ranked.headline: Linear-time graph and state-space models for diverse biomedical data modalities
ranked.summary: Memory-efficient graph and state-space architectures are now applied across histology, single-cell, EHR, and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed models resolve conformational ensembles of disordered proteins
ranked.summary: Learned models are being paired with physical or energetic priors to capture conformational variability beyond single static structures.

ranked.headline: Learned models delineate tissue and anatomy in gigapixel and tomographic imaging
ranked.summary: Adapting foundation models for tissue detection and quality control is cutting whole-slide preprocessing time and removing artifacts before downstream analysis.

ranked.headline: Mathematical models couple cooperation, infection and stochastic transmission dynamics
ranked.summary: Coupled game-epidemic, stress-infection, and Wolbachia release models probe how host and pathogen dynamics shape population outcomes.

ranked.headline: Protein-ligand modeling extends to metal sites, receptor reorganization, and induced fit
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test whether predictors and design pipelines can handle metal sites, kinase reorganization, and receptor flexibility.

ranked.headline: Sequence foundation models are benchmarked and pretrained for biomolecular prediction
ranked.summary: Genome language models are being evaluated on resistance prediction and pretrained with evolutionary objectives, moving beyond architecture alone.

ranked.headline: Open tools for simulating, modeling, and visualizing multi-omics and 3D genome data
ranked.summary: Recent published tools package simulation, metabolic modeling, multi-omics integration, and 3D genome visualization for R, Python, and Galaxy users.

ranked.headline: Software tools standardize EV analysis and expose tumor transcriptomics and plotting
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package standardized multi-instrument processing and natural-language plotting into open, accessible software for routine bioinformatic use.

ranked.headline: Reusing learned biomolecular representations for fitness and interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Protein and DNA language models are being repurposed beyond their pretraining objectives, with new emphasis on how representations are built and read out.

ranked.headline: Sample and variant structure limit what can be inferred from ancient DNA datasets
ranked.summary: Simulations, epigenetic clock assessment, and dating metadata audits now expose structural limits on inference in ancient DNA and ancient human datasets.

ranked.headline: GWAS summary-statistic methods for multi-ancestry conditional analysis and meta-analysis
ranked.summary: Multi-ancestry GWAS summary statistics are being analyzed with new conditional, joint, and meta-analysis software in early 2026 preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: In silico prediction of missense and synonymous variant functional impact across genes
ranked.summary: Recent work extends in silico pathogenicity prediction from missense to synonymous variants, alongside structure-resolved missense assessment.

ranked.headline: Non-SNV variation resolved from single-cell mosaics to biobank-scale CNV phenotypes
ranked.summary: Recent studies resolve STR mosaicism, CNVs, phased imputation and digenic risk at single-cell, biobank and multi-ancestry scales.

ranked.headline: Models show electric fields reverse durotaxis; branched cells reorient chemotactically
ranked.summary: Competing physical cues and cell morphology are now being modeled jointly to predict directed migration in complex environments.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked DIA workflows and statistics advance peptide and protein quantification
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarked datasets and DIA software reports make acquisition, software, and statistical choices directly comparable across studies.

ranked.headline: Causal and reservoir-computing models infer dynamics in neural and biological systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair causal inference, identifiable representation learning, and LLM-guided search with neural and biological dynamics data.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve transient states in condensates and membrane supercomplexes
ranked.summary: Current preprints and a 2026 publication apply MD and coarse-grained models to transient interactions in condensates and membrane supercomplexes.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link single-cell and mass spectrometry data to antibody design
ranked.summary: Single-cell and peptide-level data are now feeding standardized, benchmarked tools for antibody design, sequencing, and affinity prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational spectrum-level inference of metabolite structures from tandem MS data
ranked.summary: Tandem MS spectra are increasingly interpreted computationally, from de novo structure search to cross-polarity similarity and microbiome tracing.
